Side box used drop outs. include information number patients excluded reasons. participants exclusion reasons included next vertical node box excluded. subject id can used multiple times indicate many patients left current node. node labels, example visit number phase, can horizontally align vertical main nodes, exclusion box. 2 treatment allocation present, exclusion box allocation aligned right stage, number non-missing values counted. Set kickoff_sidebox=TRUE remove observations counted side box remaining nodes.

title: Self-generating CONSORT diagram
text: generate consort diagram data.frame, one prepare disposition data.frame. data: Dataset prepared orders: named vector list, names variable values labels box. order diagram based . Variables listed , included parameters calculate number non-missing values. list can provided multiple variables list element variables stack single node. side box 1 variable. side_box: Variable vector, appeared side box diagram. next box count number non-missing values, users need make sure correct. pariticpants id variable can used multiple times, since number non-missing calculated vertical box. allocation: Name grouping/treatment variable (optional), diagram split branches variables. labels: Named vector, names location vertical node excluding side box. position location plus 1 allocation variables allocation defined. kickoff_sidebox: kickoff observation data following side box. cex: Multiplier applied font size, Default 0.6 text_width: positive integer giving target column wrapping lines output.

title: Self-generating CONSORT diagram
text: Functions mainly three categories, main box, side box label box. Others include building function. functions used self generating function. box functions require previous node text label. - add_box: add main box, previous nodes provided first node. - add_side_box: add exclusion box. - add_split: add allocation box, nodes split groups. label text node following nodes vector length larger 1. - add_label_box: add visiting phasing label given reference node. - build_grid: don’t need unless want grob object. - build_grviz: don’t need unless want Graphviz code.

title: Self-generating CONSORT diagram
text: package supports two plotting engines: grid (grid package) Graphviz. default grid, plot(g) (assuming g consort plot object) use grid draw plot. coordinates calculated internally, one can simply use build_grviz(g) get built grob object. means can use patchwork package combine different plots. can use example add title footnotes. Although many efforts made draw plot easy possible, may still find plots difficult draw. may happy final output want plot svg format used websites. can simply plot(g, grViz = TRUE) draw plot Graphviz. need install DiagrammeR package . want twicking plot, can use build_grviz(g) extract dot file edit. can use Rstudio render plot tools prefer. Use example dump dot file.
code: library(patchwork)  wrap_elements(build_grid(g)) + plot_annotation(   title = 'Consort diagram',   subtitle = 'Flow chart of the XX study',   caption = 'Disclaimer: None of these plots are insightful' ) cat(build_grviz(g), file = "consort.gv")

title: Self-generating CONSORT diagram
text: package default settings line width, color, arrow type length. can easily changed set_consort_defaults(). example, can set set_consort_defaults(arrow_gp = gpar(col = "red", lwd = 2)) change arrow graphical parameters. Use get_consort_defaults() view current settings. default parameters : available options : gpar() options merged existing defaults, need specify properties want change. Previous settings can restored capturing return value:
code: get_consort_defaults() #> Consort diagram default settings: #>  #>   arrow_gp      : gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1) #>   txt_gp        : gpar(cex = 1, col = "black") #>   box_gp        : gpar(fill = "white") #>   label_txt_gp  : gpar(col = "#4F81BD", cex = 1, font = "bold") #>   label_box_gp  : gpar(fill = "#A9C7FD") #>   arrow_length  : 0.1 #>   arrow_type    : "closed" #>   pad_u         : 3 #>   bullet        : "•" #>   parse_markup  : FALSE set_consort_defaults(arrow_gp = gpar(col = "red", lwd = 2)) # ... draw diagram ... init_consort_defaults() # restore

title: Self-generating CONSORT diagram
text: diagram can rendered Graphviz: Formatting applied per-segment, can combine styles within single label — example "**Enrolled** (n=300)\n*p* < 0.05^{1}" renders “Enrolled” bold, “p” italic, “1” superscript footnote marker. Plain text without markup rendered exactly .
code: library(grid) set_consort_defaults(txt_gp = gpar(cex = 0.8), parse_markup = TRUE)  g <- add_box(txt = "**Patients screened** (n=300)") |>   add_side_box(txt = "Excluded^{1} (n=15):\n\u2022 MRI not collected (n=3)\n\u2022 Other (n=12)") |>   add_box(txt = "__Randomised__ (n=285)") |>   add_split(txt = c("*Arm A* (n=143)", "*Arm B* (n=142)")) |>   add_box(txt = c("Analysed (n=128)", "Analysed (n=135)")) |>   add_label_box(txt = c("1" = "Screening", "3" = "Randomisation")) plot(g) plot(g, grViz = TRUE)

title: Create Consort Diagram
text: basic example shows solve create CONSORT diagram given subject disposition data:  grid plotting ideal, calculation coodinates nodes easy job tried best. Feel free PR want improve. can produce Graphviz plot setting grViz = TRUE plot. use DiagrammeR print plot. plot ideal Shiny HTML output. save Graphviz plot png pdf
code: library(consort) library(grid) ## basic example code set.seed(1001) N <- 300  trialno <- sample(c(1000:2000), N) exc <- rep(NA, N) exc[sample(1:N, 15)] <- sample(c("Sample not collected", "MRI not collected", "Other"),                                 15, replace = T, prob = c(0.4, 0.4, 0.2))  arm <- rep(NA, N) arm[is.na(exc)] <- sample(c("Conc", "Seq"), sum(is.na(exc)), replace = T)  fow1 <- rep(NA, N) fow1[!is.na(arm)] <- sample(c("Withdraw", "Discontinued", "Death", "Other", NA),                             sum(!is.na(arm)), replace = T,                              prob = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.8)) fow2 <- rep(NA, N) fow2[!is.na(arm) & is.na(fow1)] <- sample(c("Protocol deviation", "Outcome missing", NA),                                           sum(!is.na(arm) & is.na(fow1)), replace = T,                                            prob = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.9)) df <- data.frame(trialno, exc, arm, fow1, fow2) head(df) #>   trialno  exc  arm  fow1 fow2 #> 1    1086 <NA> Conc  <NA> <NA> #> 2    1418 <NA>  Seq  <NA> <NA> #> 3    1502 <NA> Conc Death <NA> #> 4    1846 <NA> Conc  <NA> <NA> #> 5    1303 <NA> Conc Death <NA> #> 6    1838 <NA>  Seq  <NA> <NA> set_consort_defaults(txt_gp = gpar(cex = 0.6), parse_markup = TRUE)  out <- consort_plot(data = df,              order = c(trialno = "Population",                           exc    = "**Excluded**",                           arm     = "Randomized patient",                           fow1    = "Lost of Follow-up",                           trialno = "Finished Followup",                           fow2    = "Not evaluable",                           trialno = "Final Analysis"),              side_box = c("exc", "fow1", "fow2"),              allocation = "arm",              labels = c("1" = "Screening", "2" = "Randomization",                         "5" = "Final"))  plot(out) plot(out, grViz = TRUE) plot(g, grViz = TRUE) |>      DiagrammeRsvg::export_svg() |>      charToRaw() |>      rsvg::rsvg_pdf("svg_graph.pdf")

               • Other (n=8)"  g <- add_box(txt = txt1)  g <- add_side_box(g, txt = txt1_side)  g <- add_box(g, txt = "Randomized (n=200)")  g <- add_split(g, txt = c("Arm A (n=100)", "Arm B (n=100")) g <- add_side_box(g,   txt = c(     "Excluded (n=15):

                   • Tissues not collected (n=4)

                    • Tissues not collected (n=4)"   ) )  g <- add_box(g, txt = c("Final analysis (n=100)", "Final analysis (n=100")) g <- add_label_box(g, txt = c("1" = "Screening", "3" = "Randomized", "4" = "Final analysis"))
